description:
Hello,I'm Kishore Kumar Manikandan,an Ex-AI/ML Engineer and BTU Cottbus Cyber Security Master's student.

Project C.O.S.M.I.C. AEGIS an offline, camera-based AI medical guardian for astronauts in deep space. I have the core AI and security architecture covered, but I need an awesome crew to bring it to life:

Frontend/UI Devs: To build a sleek mission control dashboard.

Hardware Hackers: To integrate camera feeds and edge devices.

Medical Enthusiasts: To structure space medicine protocols.
